HARDENING_ABSORBED: O-1: every attempt row carries tenant_id and a lease (holder id, expiry, fencing token); claiming or resuming a running row requires a fencing-token CAS; the persisted prompt excludes secret material; implemented as a run-scoped namespace of the PG journal, not a second writer.

RESTATE-INVOCATION-ID: one invocation ID (mission ID, attempt sequence, UUIDv7) names exactly one logical execution; singularity enforced by a journal unique constraint on (invocation ID, step key); IDs are never bearer capabilities; tenant embedded in the routing key; attach/output rendezvous requires independent authorization.

orka-write-once-execution-binding: binding creation is itself a canonical event with recorded authorization and input digests; the binding carries a freshness bound (policy/config versions, valid-until) and a single-holder lease with fencing token; every worker action validates against the frozen binding AND the holder lease AND the freshness bound, never against live coordinator state; credential references only, never secrets; tenant bound into the binding identity.

orka-single-control-authority: exactly one control authority (CRX PG journal single-writer); every auxiliary store commits under its fences or does not commit; no independent commit path exists. Assumption that must hold: the controller epoch and session fences are anchored in a lease external to the fenced stores.
HOW_IT_WORKS: Before dispatch, the coordinator emits a RUN_BINDING event to ping_events: (tenant_id, invocation_id=(mission_id, attempt_seq, uuid7), worker_profile, input_digest, authorization_snapshot, policy_version, holder lease {holder_id, expiry, fencing_token}). Spawn requests claim the attempt via atomic claim(tenant, invocation_id, ttl); exactly one claimant wins and the claim names the winning execution so duplicate requesters attach to it instead of double-spawning. Workers may only mutate the row through status transitions; claiming or resuming a running row requires a fencing-token CAS. Every action is validated against the frozen binding plus the live holder lease plus the freshness bound. The PG journal is the sole writer; any auxiliary store commits inside the journal transaction or not at all.
DOES_NOT_SOLVE: Lease granularity is coarse: a hung (not dead) worker holds the lease until expiry, delaying recovery. Prompt redaction quality is assumed, not proven. A crashed holder with an overlong lease needs an external reaper; pair with COMBO-CAUSATION-OBSERVABILITY's supervised watcher.
EVIDENCE_GRADE: source-backed: mechanism invariants, CRX analogs, and all hardening above (mechanisms.jsonl records; redteam verdicts for the four reviewed mechanisms). inferred: composition behavior and record shapes. unreviewed: HATCHET-IDEMPOTENCY-CLAIM was not among the 23 red-teamed candidates; its atomic-claim semantics are source-verified (hatchet pkg/repository/idempotency.go) but carry no adversarial verdict.

HARDENING_ABSORBED: oa-tool-invocation-ledger (load-bearing): executed splits into planned and dispatched; dispatched=True requires the provider/transport ack at the true side-effect boundary; completed=True implies a claimant-recorded receipt labeled unverified-claim until independently evidenced; completion entries are write-once per call ID; on recovery, planned-and-not-dispatched is safe to retry while dispatched-and-not-completed is OutcomeUnknown.

oa-tool-invocation-identity: the fingerprint is an exactness key, not a retry key; retry-stable dedupe needs a separate idempotency scope excluding environment and caller, or an explicit caller-supplied idempotency key; key ledger lookups by (tenant, idempotency key).

DBOS-STEP-RECORDING: per-step effect-class labels (transactional / idempotent-external / at-least-once-external); for transactional effects the step record and effects commit atomically; for external effects the record is a claim, re-execution bounded to the unrecorded suffix, at-least-once steps carry provider idempotency keys; step records written only by the step owner's identity; external-effect outputs carry provider receipts or are labeled unverified-claim.

orka-outcome-unknown-fail-closed: the side-effect boundary is defined by externally observable ack, never local state-machine position; OutcomeUnknown records cite last-observed evidence; a prompt past a boundary that cannot be proven uncrossed is never re-submitted; no-replay enforced in the recovery path and covered by a journal check.

MCP-M04: CANCELLED is terminal only on server-confirmed cancellation or proof the handler never started; unconfirmed abandonment settles to OutcomeUnknown with last-observed evidence; idempotency keys on all side-effecting tool calls.

MCP-M06: handler execution time is bounded by the host, not the SDK: the worker enforces an execution budget and kills over-budget handlers, emitting a canonical TIMED_OUT event (distinct from FAILED) with the budget recorded on the call.
HOW_IT_WORKS: Each tool step is journaled as TOOL_PLANNED (semantic fingerprint plus retry-stable idempotency key (tenant, idem_key), effect class) then TOOL_DISPATCHED (written only on the transport/provider ack at the side-effect boundary) then TOOL_RECEIPT (provider receipt digest, or labeled unverified-claim; write-once per call ID). Re-execution after a crash replays the journal prefix: planned-not-dispatched is safe to retry; dispatched-not-completed becomes OutcomeUnknown citing last-observed evidence, never replayed; completed returns the recorded result, never re-executed. Abandonment sends the cancel signal; CANCELLED requires server confirmation, else OutcomeUnknown. The host watchdog kills handlers over budget and emits TIMED_OUT. Recovery never resumes in place: crashed attempts move to a recovery queue and workers claim through the atomic dequeue, the single serialization point, so concurrent recovery converges. Every failure receipt carries a typed OR_FAILURE_CLASSIFICATION value; retryable=true is the only license to retry.
DOES_NOT_SOLVE: A lying provider ack defeats dispatched=True; genuine verification needs COMBO-CONTRADICTION-RESOLUTION's evaluator receipts. The live MCP transport itself is not in the library (see INV-1); this combination is the durable record around the transport, proven with a deterministic fake provider behind the same journal interface.
EVIDENCE_GRADE: source-backed: mechanism invariants and all hardening above (mechanisms.jsonl; redteam verdicts for the six reviewed mechanisms). inferred: composition behavior, flag-combination recovery table. unreviewed: RESTATE-JOURNAL, DBOS-ATOMIC-RECOVERY, OR_FAILURE_CLASSIFICATION were not red-teamed; their journal-prefix-replay, recovery-as-enqueue, and typed-classification semantics are source-verified but carry no adversarial verdict.

HARDENING_ABSORBED: orka-outcome-unknown-fail-closed: boundary by externally observable ack; OutcomeUnknown cites last-observed evidence; no replay past an uncrossed boundary; no-replay covered by a journal check.

RESTATE-INVOCATION-ID: the same invocation ID names the logical execution across provider rotation; journal unique constraint on (invocation ID, step key) prevents double execution of the same step; IDs are never capabilities.
HOW_IT_WORKS: Provider death mid-run produces a ProviderAttempt receipt with a typed classification (timeout, network_error, provider_5xx; retryable=true is the only license to retry; quota_exhausted is never retryable). Rotation walks the declared fallback chain: the effective chain is always a subsequence of the declared, already-authorized chain, filtered to enabled and not-yet-tried providers, never reordered or extended. The rotated attempt keeps the same invocation ID, so if the dead provider actually executed the step (unknown), the journal shows dispatched-not-completed and the step settles to OutcomeUnknown instead of replaying; if the boundary was provably uncrossed, the step re-dispatches under the new provider with the same idempotency key. The self-healing manager excludes the dead provider with backoff and hysteresis (re-admission strictly harder than exclusion); fleet-wide failure (majority of circuits open) narrows to exploitation only, never widens.
DOES_NOT_SOLVE: 'Provider died before the side effect' vs 'provider died after it' is undecidable without a provider ack; rotation does not resolve it, the OutcomeUnknown terminal state carries it honestly.
EVIDENCE_GRADE: source-backed: mechanism invariants and hardening above. inferred: cross-mechanism interaction (rotation preserving invocation ID). unreviewed: OR_FAILURE_CLASSIFICATION, OR_DECLARATIVE_FALLBACK_CHAINS, OR_SELF_HEALING_EXCLUSION were not red-teamed.

HARDENING_ABSORBED: oa-approval-scope-fingerprint (load-bearing): same scope fingerprint implies same tool target, NOT same authorization target; grants are tiered (scope-level for low-risk tools, argument-bound semantic fingerprints or allowlist constraints for sensitive tools); every cached grant binds the policy/config version it was issued under and is re-validated at execution time; tenant in the scope fingerprint.

MCP-M26: authorization checked at discovery AND at execution against a context minted by the authentication layer and bound to the transport session, never caller-asserted; missing context denies; forbidden tools indistinguishable from absent ones; grants epoch/lease-bound with handler-start binding and periodic re-verification for long handlers; no local-process exemption; grant epoch logged on every execution.

LANGGRAPH-INTERRUPT: interrupts bind the authorized responder identity, the exact payload shown, and the semantic fingerprint of the proposed action; resume is a data command with responder provenance and a single-writer CAS on the checkpoint version; execution validates the action still matches the approved fingerprint and the policy version current at approval; interrupt IDs unguessable; answers become evidence events (who answered, what they saw, schema validation), not trusted data.

oa-guardrail-tripwire-audit: a tripped guardrail halts the run via a typed, non-retryable exception; sibling guardrails cancelled and awaited under a bound (hung sibling killed and logged); every completed guardrail result sink-appended before propagation, sink failure a loud typed gap event that never un-trips the guardrail; enforcement at the tool boundary server-side; result excerpts redacted before sink.

OBS-8CHECKS: execution-without-authorization exists as a preventive dispatch gate (not only a detective query); authorization receipts are emitted by the authorization authority, never by the authorized party; execution-start events are emitted by the dispatcher, not the worker.
HOW_IT_WORKS: Tool-call dispatch path, in order: (1) discovery-time filtering hides forbidden tools (ambiguous denial); (2) the dispatch gate checks the grant: scope fingerprint plus argument-bound fingerprint for sensitive tools, tenant, and policy version, issued by the authorization authority; receipts are authority-emitted; execution-start events are dispatcher-emitted; (3) at handler start the grant is re-checked against the authenticator-minted, session-bound context; long handlers re-verify on a schedule; (4) sensitive actions raise an interrupt record (gate ID, payload shown, schema, raising attempt, bound responder); the attempt suspends on a journaled awakeable holding no worker thread; the responder's answer resolves the awakeable as a journaled event with provenance and is single-writer CAS; (5) execution validates the action still matches the approved semantic fingerprint and the current policy version; (6) guardrails run server-side at the tool boundary; a trip is a typed non-retryable failure with the redacted result sink-appended first.
DOES_NOT_SOLVE: Mint-time compromise: every authorization mechanism here trusts its minter (redteam cross-cutting finding B); a compromised authorization authority vouches for attacks downstream. The check-to-handler-start race is narrowed (handler-start binding) but not closed for revocation between re-check and first instruction. Human responder authentication on the approval surface is assumed; no library mechanism covers it.
EVIDENCE_GRADE: source-backed: mechanism invariants and all hardening above (mechanisms.jsonl; redteam verdicts for MCP-M26, oa-approval-scope-fingerprint, LANGGRAPH-INTERRUPT, oa-guardrail-tripwire-audit, OBS-8CHECKS). inferred: the ordered dispatch path composition. unreviewed: RESTATE-AWAKEABLE was not red-teamed; its at-most-once journaled resolution semantics are source-verified. Note: OBS-8CHECKS is the redteam bundle ID for the observability lane's 8-check detection table (redteam README: treated as one candidate); it is not a mechanisms.jsonl record. Its hardening comes from redteam verdicts.jsonl.

HARDENING_ABSORBED: LETTA-GIT-MEMORY: backend unavailability fails correction writes closed (or queues them) with a loud typed event, never silently degrades to destructive writes; every commit carries provenance (causation id, source event); redaction runs before the write; per-block writes serialized by CAS on the expected commit; tenant-scoped stores with hosting-layer access control; a defined secret-purge procedure under dual control for the inevitable miss.

GRAPHITI-BITEMPORAL-INVALIDATE (load-bearing): supersession is append-only AND trust-gated: a contradicting edge supersedes only with provenance trust at least equal to the edge it supersedes and with evidenced valid_at (un-evidenced valid_at defaults to ingestion time, never the future); otherwise it is recorded as a contested candidate; contradiction resolves to timestamp stamps, never mutation or deletion; skipped overlaps emit a typed conflict event.

MEM0-EXPIRATION (load-bearing): a memory past its expiration_date is invisible to default reads, the row retained for audit; any row whose expiration_date cannot be parsed is treated as expired and quarantined with a typed event; expiration changes are versioned events with writer identity, and shortening another writer's expiration requires explicit authority.

MEMORYBANK-EBBINGHAUS (load-bearing): retention is a deterministic function of (time-since-recall, strength); decay applies only to derived-cache memories, never to evidence-grade or provenance records; deletion is a tombstone (recoverable, auditable), never a destructive pop; reinforcement happens only through retrieval in verified contexts, never on mere surfacing; initial strength capped unless evidenced; any randomness seeded and logged for replay.

CHAMNAN-REDACTOR: no string enters the memory store through any ingress (API, sync, import, restore, backfill) without passing the redactor; redactor quality measured on a corpus including real-shape and adversarial variants (split, encoded, prefixed) with scheduled re-measurement and regression alerting; the redactor is one layer in a defense in depth (structured secret passing by reference, output-side scanning), never the sole gate.
HOW_IT_WORKS: Memory writes are journaled events (memory_committed: writer identity, trust tier, evidence refs, causation_id) into an append-only store where every state is recoverable by commit. Retrieval during execution is itself a journaled event (memory_retrieved: cited memory IDs, retrieval strategy as an explicit per-query parameter, declared token budget never exceeded); hybrid RRF ranking means no single signal vetoes a candidate the others rank highly. Corrections are new commits; projections compute 'current' from the log, so re-emission resolves to the latest commit and can never demote an approved node. Forgetting has two paths: declarative expiration_date evaluated at projection time (fail-closed quarantine on unparseable dates) and deterministic decay of derived-cache entries with tombstones. Ingestion is trust-gated: redaction at every ingress, provenance trust tier assigned, contradictions become contested candidates requiring confirmation before they can supersede.
DOES_NOT_SOLVE: Paraphrase-level memory use without ID citation is undetectable by set difference (redteam residual). Read-time expiration cannot retract content already retrieved into agent context. Append-only stores cannot purge secrets or honor erasure; the purge path is invention-required (INV-4).
EVIDENCE_GRADE: source-backed: mechanism invariants and all hardening above (mechanisms.jsonl; redteam verdicts for all five reviewed mechanisms). inferred: composition behavior (retrieval-as-journaled-event). unreviewed: GRAPHITI-HYBRID-RRF and LIGHTRAG-TOKEN-BUDGET were not red-teamed.

HARDENING_ABSORBED: OBS-8CHECKS: the eight checks are detective backstops over the canonical journal, but authorization and duplicate-execution checks also exist as preventive gates (dispatch-time authorization re-check; unique constraint on the deterministic execution key); authorization receipts emitted by the authorization authority, never the authorized party; execution-start events emitted by the dispatcher, not the worker; receipts pin policy, config, and snapshot versions so the stale-snapshot check is non-vacuous; external-effect receipts carry independent evidence or are labeled claims. Preconditions CRX must close: causation_id on mission lifecycle events; wired observability classes; non-empty tables.

ORCA-14: durability is not delivery: terminal transitions are durably queued AND delivered over a live path with its own liveness proof; the watcher runs supervised (restart on death), carries a durable cursor (exactly-once delivery per transition), its poll interval is shorter than the shortest lease or approval window it serves; idempotent consumers; one watcher multiplexed per coordinator over N lanes.
oa-guardrail-tripwire-audit: every completed guardrail result sink-appended before propagation; sink failure is a loud typed gap event.
HOW_IT_WORKS: Every lifecycle event carries causation_id (the parent link), making missing-parent a preventive foreign-key violation rather than a detective finding; all events join on (tenant, invocation_id, causation_id). The eight checks run as both PG constraints/triggers (preventive: authorization gate, execution-key uniqueness, version-pinned receipts) and scheduled detective queries (bounded anti-joins on tenant-scoped indexes). A supervised watcher per coordinator drains the durable event stream with a cursor and delivers wakeups inside a latency SLA bound to the shortest lease/approval window; consumers are idempotent. The explain surface reports only emitted events (never recomputed): decision traces with skip reasons from a fixed allowlist, routing metadata only, no request bodies or credentials; every trace entry is sink-appended before propagation so post-hoc explanation is audit-complete.
DOES_NOT_SOLVE: Paraphrase-level memory use without citation remains undetectable. The supervisor is a new liveness root: its own death is covered only by coordinator startup reaping (DBOS-ATOMIC-RECOVERY path), which is coarse. Detective queries at 1k tenants need tenant-scoped indexes from day one or they become the bottleneck.
EVIDENCE_GRADE: source-backed: mechanism invariants and hardening above. inferred: preventive/constraint form of the checks; watcher multiplexing. unreviewed: ORCA-14's watcher was red-teamed; OR_ROUTE_EXPLAIN_ENDPOINT and OR_COMBO_DECISION_TRACE were not. Note: OBS-8CHECKS is the redteam bundle ID for the observability lane's 8-check detection table (redteam README: treated as one candidate); it is not a mechanisms.jsonl record. Its hardening comes from redteam verdicts.jsonl.

HARDENING_ABSORBED: GRAPHITI-BITEMPORAL-INVALIDATE (load-bearing): contradictory claims land as contested candidates unless the new claim's provenance trust meets or exceeds the claim it supersedes; contradiction resolves to stamps, never mutation; typed conflict events on unresolved overlap.
orka-single-control-authority: exactly one control authority resolves the contradiction; auxiliary stores commit under its fences or not at all.
DBOS-STEP-RECORDING: step records are written only by the step owner's identity, defeating writer spoofing; external-effect outputs carry provider receipts or are labeled unverified-claim.
oa-tool-invocation-ledger (load-bearing): receipts graded verified-vs-claimed; completions write-once per call ID, so a stale worker cannot overwrite a real result with a fabrication.
HOW_IT_WORKS: When two workers produce contradictory claims for the same (tenant, invocation_id, step_key), both land as journal events with writer identity; neither is deleted. The contradiction emits a typed conflict event and each claim is graded: evaluator-recorded receipts (test outcomes recorded by the independent evaluator authority, CAS-verified publication against expected content at the expected ref, provider receipt digests) outrank bare claimant assertions, which stay labeled unverified-claim. Resolution is a single-writer decision event citing the winning evidence (evaluator receipt IDs, evidence digests, CAS result); the losing claim remains as a contested candidate, preserving the audit trail. Duplicate claimants on the same idempotency key attach to the winner's execution rather than spawning rival executions.
DOES_NOT_SOLVE: Which evidence outranks which in a given domain is policy, not mechanism (INV-2). A compromised evaluator defeats the scheme; the evaluator authority is trusted (redteam finding B applies). Two claims with equal evidence remain honestly unresolved as a typed conflict; the mechanism refuses to force a winner.
EVIDENCE_GRADE: source-backed: mechanism invariants and hardening above. inferred: the grading ladder (evaluator receipts outrank claimant assertions) and the conflict-event flow. unreviewed: SWEA-INDEPENDENT-EVALUATOR-RECEIPT, orka-cas-verified-publication, HATCHET-IDEMPOTENCY-CLAIM were not red-teamed. This combination is the direct answer to redteam cross-cutting finding A (no harvested mechanism verifies worker claims against independent evidence).

HARDENING_ABSORBED: BORS-PREFLIGHT-MERGE-GATE: approval meaningful only when bound to the exact commit being merged; required checks present and green at gate time AND re-verified at land time (CAS on the target ref: land only if the ref still equals the SHA the batch was built and tested on); the queue effective only as the sole write path to the target ref; every unmet condition a distinct typed block event.

BORS-HEAD-RACE-DETECTION: head movement detected before batch assembly (:race, retryable, never conflated with :conflict) AND re-verified at land time; batch assembly is single-writer (one batcher holds the queue lease).
HOW_IT_WORKS: The candidate integration tree is synthesized on the current base; the independent evaluator runs required checks against that exact tree and records the receipt (evaluator failure is a failure outcome, never a pass). The gate binds approvals to the tree SHA and blocks on any unmet condition as a typed event. Landing is a CAS on the target ref: it commits only if the ref still equals the tested SHA; any head movement between test and land becomes :race (re-evaluate against the new base) or :conflict (needs rebase), never a silent landing. After the CAS, an independent read-back verifies the landed ref's content hash (VerifiedExact) or emits a typed delivery outcome including PublicationOutcomeUnknown.
DOES_NOT_SOLVE: The evaluator environment's own integrity (who verifies the verifier) is assumed. Flaky tests produce honest failures, not passes, by design; flakiness triage is out of scope.
EVIDENCE_GRADE: source-backed: mechanism invariants and hardening above. inferred: the pipeline order. unreviewed: BORS-TEST-EXACT-INTEGRATION-TREE, SWEA-INDEPENDENT-EVALUATOR-RECEIPT, orka-cas-verified-publication were not red-teamed.

HOW_IT_WORKS: Candidate next-tasks are scored with evidence-graded fitness: user override beats measured performance beats catalog tier beats neutral baseline; every score carries its provenance layer; unknown capability is the neutral midpoint, never a penalty; retired items can never earn a positive score from stale data. A deterministic dry-run preview shows what would be claimed with zero side effects and zero state mutation; the preview is advisory and never authorizes execution. The coordinator claims the top candidate via atomic claim(tenant, task_key, ttl): exactly one claimant wins, losers attach to the winner's execution, expired claims are evicted. Admission control sits downstream of authorization and upstream of dispatch: it sheds load on capacity pressure (explicit off/shadow/enforce modes) and never decides authorization. The decision trace records scores, factors, and skip reasons from a fixed allowlist for the explain step; traces never contain request bodies or credentials.
DOES_NOT_SOLVE: Where candidate tasks come from is not in the library (INV-3); for the first mission the backlog is a seeded, human-approved list. Fitness evidence is only as good as recorded outcomes: garbage in, ranked garbage.
EVIDENCE_GRADE: source-backed: mechanism invariants (mechanisms.jsonl). inferred: the claim pipeline composition. unreviewed: none of these five mechanisms were red-teamed; no adversarial verdict exists for any of them. This combination carries the highest unreviewed risk in the set.
